output.headline: Price-forward sponsor with provider deals in the target's sub-sector and adjacent ones, but a smaller typical deal size and no open platform.
output.differentiator: Pays at the top of the range: its 15.7x median exceeds the comparable-deal 75th percentile of 15.3x, and sits above the medians of Advocate, Nordic, UPMC, Advent and GTCR. [V:comps, B:buyer]
output.why_them: Pays upper-quartile multiples; provider record, but smaller typical cheques

acquirer_overview.title: A global sponsor with a mixed record, half of it in provider services
points: Financial sponsor with 18 deals from 2016 to 2023; 15 closed (83%). Parent reports $303.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025. [T:record, K:closed_share, P:1]
Home sub-sector is Health Insurance (4 deals); 9 of 18 deals are provider services and 9 sit outside it. [K:by_sub_sector, A:angles, T:record]
Median deal $88M, largest $1,388M; 17 of 18 were control deals (94%). [T:record, K:control_share]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A credible provider buyer, but without a platform to add this onto
points: Holds 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; prior purchases from this kind of seller are a modest factor in its likelihood. [T:record, S:own_fit_s]
Growth was a stated motive in 10 of 18 deals (41% of all deals in the file), which fits the target's 11.0% revenue growth. [M:high_growth, X:target]
No open platform in the sub-sector, so this would be a new investment rather than an add-on. Prior Midwest purchasing is a slight factor against. [A:angles, S:geo_fit]

precedent_activity.title: Relevant precedents are near the target's size, but mostly priced below 15.7x
points: Quality Medical Group (Healthcare Services, $187M, Minority Investment, 2022) at 11.2x is the same-sub-sector precedent, but a minority stake rather than control. [D:MA-2022-0350]
Granite Dental Network ($203M, Platform Investment, 2021) at 12.2x; Liberty Addiction Treatment ($118M, Leveraged Buyout, 2021) at 8.8x. [D:MA-2021-0439, D:MA-2021-0369]
8 of 18 deals fall in the $100M-$400M size band; only one deal, the $15M Metro Medical Associates in 2018, was in the Midwest. [K:size_band, D:MA-2018-0415]

valuation_context.title: Margin supports the 75th percentile; TPG has paid there before
points: Comparable deals (70) price at 10.7x to 15.3x EBITDA, median 12.8x; the 75th percentile needs $13.1M of EBITDA. [V:comps]
Margin of 16.8% sits above the comps' median of 12.9% and above 87% of comps, supporting upper-quartile pricing; TPG's own median paid is 15.7x. [V:comps]
At 5.0x leverage and an equity cheque of $128M, IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target; maximum price is $193M, or $216M on a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $88M is under half the $200M EV. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 of 18 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band and the largest was $1,388M. [K:size_band, T:record]
risk_flags.reality: It has the capacity but not a typical-size record, which is why conviction is Low. [C:conviction]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites that exit, yet it has no open platform. [V:lbo, A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Midwest and control fit
risk_flags.concern: Only one past deal in the target's region, and the same-sub-sector precedent was a minority stake. [T:record, D:MA-2022-0350]
risk_flags.mitigant: Control deals were 17 of 18, and the Midwest is not a barrier to a sponsor with national reach. [K:control_share, K:by_region]
risk_flags.reality: Sponsors on the priority list with deeper Midwest records are likely to compete. [S:geo_fit, R:rank]

conviction.rationale: One same-sub-sector and eight adjacent provider deals support the case. No open platform in the sub-sector is neutral. A median deal of $88M, under half the $200M EV, weighs against. [C:conviction, T:record]
